## Description

What happened, and what did you expect?

## Steps to reproduce

Use fictional hostnames and accounts. Include the application version, Windows version, theme/display scaling and whether a jump host is involved.

## Evidence

Review screenshots and diagnostics before attaching them. Do not upload real configurations, credentials, keys, host fingerprints, databases, logs containing identifiers, or the application data directory. Report security vulnerabilities through the private channel described in SECURITY.md.
